tabs.tab_title: Does it work with my current WordPress theme?
tabs.tab_content: Yes! NewsOS is built to be 100% compatible with any standard WordPress theme, including Astra, GeneratePress, Flavor, and all others. It works perfectly with both the Gutenberg Block Editor and the Classic Editor.

tabs.tab_title: Is it compatible with Yoast SEO and Rank Math?
tabs.tab_content: Absolutely. NewsOS is designed as an Enterprise Schema Extension. It reads data from Yoast SEO or Rank Math and builds an advanced Semantic Knowledge Graph (JSON-LD) on top of it. Zero conflicts.

tabs.tab_title: Will it slow down my website?
tabs.tab_content: No. NewsOS is built for high-traffic news websites. It uses event-driven JavaScript (zero CPU idle load), smart database caching, and strict timeouts on all external API calls. Your frontend speed is unaffected.

tabs.tab_title: How does the license key work?
tabs.tab_content: After purchasing PRO, you receive a license key via email instantly. Enter it in your WordPress dashboard under NewsOS → Settings → License. One license works on unlimited sites. Your license auto-renews yearly and you can cancel anytime.

tabs.tab_title: Can I upgrade from Free to PRO?
tabs.tab_content: Yes! Your Free version settings, tasks, and data are fully preserved when you activate PRO. Just install the PRO plugin, enter your license key, and all premium features unlock instantly. Zero data loss.

tabs.tab_title: What happens if I cancel my PRO subscription?
tabs.tab_content: Your site continues to work normally. All content, schema markup, and settings created with PRO remain intact. You simply stop receiving new PRO features and priority support. You can reactivate anytime.
